cumulativeAxioms.title: Lapidary Inversion Principle
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Textual legibility does not require intrinsic pigment contrast; it can emerge dynamically as a function of raking incident light and cast relief umbras.

cumulativeAxioms.title: Spatial Suture through Directional Shadow
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Cast shadows act as non-local semantic ligatures across fractured layout planes, satisfying Gestalt closure across fissures up to 80px.

cumulativeAxioms.title: Non-Newtonian Typographic Viscosity
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Governing tracking and glyph deformation via fluid surface tension allows rapid navigation to condense words into Bouma silhouettes with chromatic fringing, relaxing into classical editorial proportion at rest.

cumulativeAxioms.title: Acoustic Nodal Purity
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Typographic stem stability is a function of resonant acoustic harmonics. Sweeping into integer harmonic nodes arrests vibration, restoring 100% standing wave sharpness.

cumulativeAxioms.title: Atmospheric Capillary Bleed
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Digital letterforms behave as breathing ecological membranes when coupled with micro-climatic relative humidity, expanding stroke weight up to 45% and feathering ink into permanent organic stains upon evaporation.

cumulativeAxioms.title: Tensile Crease Delamination
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Mechanical fold curvature induces material fracture limits on printed typography. When acute folding exceeds binder yield limits, brittle ink delaminates along the fold apex, revealing raw white cellulose as an organic morphological scar.

cumulativeAxioms.title: Subtractive Spectral Quenching
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Meaning in physical multi-layer substrates is generated through subtractive light extinction rather than additive luminescence. Bringing dispersed translucent CMY layers into physical registration quenches transmitted white light according to the Beer-Lambert law, forging pitch-black composite typography.

cumulativeAxioms.title: Magneto-Optical Vectoring & Rosensweig Instability
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Digital typography can be sculpted by continuous electromagnetic force fields rather than Cartesian Bézier control points. Surpassing the Rosensweig critical threshold (B > 35 Gauss) triggers spontaneous normal-field instability, erupting needle-sharp conical spikes along flux lines.

cumulativeAxioms.title: Coulomb Electrostatic Accumulation
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Digital typography can emerge as a transient physical state held together by electrostatic potential rather than permanent raster matrices. Triboelectric surface friction across a dielectric selenium plate generates latent electrostatic fields, pulling airborne dry carbon toner dust along Coulomb force gradients into dense, velvety glyph structures. Grounding instantly drops potential to zero, shattering words into airborne soot.

cumulativeAxioms.title: Photoluminescent Quantum Decay
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Digital typography can exist as an expiring quantum event rather than permanent pixel furniture. Actinic ultraviolet photon exposure (365nm) excites zinc-sulfide crystals within letterforms into high-energy triplet states; in the absence of light, atoms continuously leak photons (530nm emerald green) along the Becquerel power-law decay curve, decaying past readability within 2.5 half-lives. Reading is transformed from a passive spatial scan into an urgent temporal ritual of photonic revival.

cumulativeAxioms.title: Forensic Narrative Feasibility
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Mythological and epic narratives achieve transcendent aesthetic gravity when corroborated by structural engineering and biophysical limit states. Carrying 40 hoplites (4.1 tonnes) inside an 11.2m timber horse requires an enclosed 38.4 m³ cavity where hypoxia becomes fatal in 9.2 hours without micro-ventilation, and whose 4.1m track necessitates breaching the 3.2m Scaean Gate.

cumulativeAxioms.title: Scale Invariance of Information Topology
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Visual networks and information hierarchies exhibit universal scale invariance across 42 orders of magnitude. The 10^11 neurons of the human cerebellum (10^-6m) and the 10^11 galaxies of the cosmic web (10^+26m) converge on an identical power-law spatial spectral density (P(k) ∝ k^-2.5) and clustering coefficient (C ≈ 0.38). Typographic visual hierarchy is an expression of self-organized criticality.

cumulativeAxioms.title: Relativistic Geodesic Deflection
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Visual meaning and reading trajectories are not neutral Cartesian constants; they are curved by narrative and ideological gravitational mass. When an ideological singularity accumulates immense mass M, rectilinear editorial columns deflect along Einstein's relativistic geodesic equation alpha = 4GM / (c^2 * b), warping into concentric golden Einstein rings and mirrored double-arcs, while crossing the Schwarzschild event horizon annihilates textual transmission into complete zero-lux void.

cumulativeAxioms.title: Cellular Computational Genesis at the Edge of Chaos
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Visual language at rest is an artificial freeze-frame. When released into cellular automaton dynamics, text operates as an open thermodynamic system balancing at Langton's critical phase threshold (lambda ≈ 0.273). Still Lifes serve as nouns, Oscillators sustain grammatical clock pulses, and Gliders project momentum across space, proving that living typography is a self-organizing linguistic biome.
cumulativeAxioms.mathematicalRelation: S_{t+1}(x,y) = f(sum_{(dx,dy) in M} S_t(x+dx, y+dy)), lambda ≈ 0.273

cumulativeAxioms.title: Morphogenetic Homeostatic Boundary
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Letterforms are not frozen Bézier outlines; they are dynamic dissipative structures governed by non-linear reaction-diffusion kinetics. Seeding typography as chemical activator fields v within a diffusing substrate inhibitor u (Du ≈ 2Dv) establishes a biological homeostatic boundary. Modulating Pearson parameters (F, k) allows text to organically navigate between stable bone skeletons (F ≈ 0.054, k ≈ 0.063), self-healing zebra labyrinth corridors (F ≈ 0.037, k ≈ 0.060), and mitotic dividing clones (F ≈ 0.026, k ≈ 0.055), proving that living language can autonomously repair structural lacerations and adapt its morphological weight to ambient chemical environments.

cumulativeAxioms.title: Synaptic Saccadic Potentiation
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Typographic hierarchy is not an immutable broadcast; it is an adaptive neural connectome rewired by cognitive attention. Coupling reading eye-saccade sequences to Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity (STDP) allows co-activated words to undergo Long-Term Potentiation (Δw_ij = η · x_i · x_j), physically pulling related concepts together through spring-tension kerning contraction and scaling Variable Font weights from Hairline (wght 100) to Ultra-Black (wght 900). Unvisited peripheral words decay into resting backgrounds under Oja's normalization (Δw = -γ · w), proving that digital typography can dynamically learn and mirror the reader's unique cognitive trace.
